content.text: {"condition":"Exercise-induced hypoglycemia","evaluationParameters":["Continuous glucose monitor readings before, during, and for several hours after cycling including overnight","Recurrence and severity of hypoglycemia symptoms on cycling versus noncycling days"],"missingInformation":["Type, dose, and timing of insulin relative to the cycling session","Timing and carbohydrate content of the preexercise meal or snack","Preexercise CGM value and glucose trend arrow before the ride","Intensity of cycling and whether it is steady-state aerobic","Occurrence of nocturnal hypoglycemia on cycling days","Client's hypoglycemia awareness and prior episodes","Whether fast-acting carbohydrate is carried during rides"],"priorityActions":["Treat acute hypoglycemia with 15 g of fast-acting carbohydrate and recheck glucose in 15 minutes, repeating until glucose is above 70 mg/dL","Consume 15 to 30 g of additional carbohydrate before cycling and reduce the preceding insulin dose on exercise days per provider protocol"],"reasoning":"Client with type 1 diabetes has adrenergic and neuroglycopenic symptoms with CGM-confirmed glucose 58 to 64 mg/dL only during or within one hour after cycling, while noncycling glucose is normal. No illness or ketones are present, and insulin/meals were not adjusted for the new exercise. This pattern is classic for exercise-induced hypoglycemia due to increased insulin-mediated glucose uptake during aerobic activity without compensatory carbohydrate increase or insulin reduction.","stage1Confidence":"high","stemEvidence":[{"stemFact":"Client with type 1 diabetes","target":"condition"},{"stemFact":"Sweating, tremor, and difficulty concentrating during the ride or within one hour afterward","target":"condition"},{"stemFact":"CGM readings were 58 to 64 mg/dL on cycling days","target":"priorityAction1"},{"stemFact":"Noncycling fasting and premeal glucose 95 to 140 mg/dL","target":"evaluationParameter2"},{"stemFact":"Continued preexisting meal and insulin plan without an exercise-day adjustment","target":"priorityAction2"},{"stemFact":"Began a new 45-minute cycling routine after work","target":"evaluationParameter1"},{"stemFact":"Symptoms recurred on three cycling days","target":"evaluationParameter2"},{"stemFact":"CGM already in use with readings during and after exercise","target":"evaluationParameter1"}]}
